species: human (HUVEC and cerebrovascular endothelial cell lines)
readout_other: Real-time qRT-PCR of VEGFA, FGF2, and eNOS mRNA expression
direction_notes: This in vitro dose-finding study examined ultrasound effects on angiogenic/eNOS gene expression rather than neural excitatory or inhibitory activity. VEGF and eNOS mRNA were significantly upregulated at sound pressures of 0.05-0.5 MPa (and FGF2 at 0.5 MPa) with a 20% duty cycle at 0.5 MHz, with loss of effect at pressures above 1.08 MPa.

exposures.label: In vitro LIPUS dose-finding irradiation of cultured vascular endothelial cells (HUVEC; final validation in cerebrovascular endothelial cells)

target.label: cultured vascular endothelial cells (HUVEC and cerebrovascular endothelial cells) irradiated through an agar phantom gel

timing.protocol_description: Cultured HUVEC were exposed to LIPUS through an agar phantom gel at frequency 0.5, 1.0, or 1.875 MHz; duty cycle 1, 5, 10, 20, or 40%; and amplitude 0.05-2.2 MPa, for 20 min (n=12 per condition), with pulse repetition rate (period) fixed at 320 microseconds. Based on this dose-response mapping (optimal duty cycle up to 20% at 0.5 MHz; effective sound pressure range 0.05-0.5 MPa), a final validation experiment in cerebrovascular endothelial cells compared two candidate human treatment conditions: (1) sound pressure just below the probe of 1.3 MPa (tissue amplitude 0.15 MPa) with duty cycle 5%, and (2) sound pressure just below the probe of 0.9 MPa (tissue amplitude 0.1 MPa) with duty cycle 10%; condition 1 produced significantly greater VEGF mRNA upregulation and was selected as the final human treatment condition.

flags.reason: Converted directly from the stated pulse repetition period (PRT = 320 microseconds, i.e. 1/320us = 3125 Hz); the paper itself calls this value 'pulse repetition rate' but states it as a time period rather than a frequency.
Paper reports n=12 cultures per condition across many frequency/duty-cycle/pressure combinations plus a separate final validation experiment; no single total subject/culture count is stated.
A non-irradiated control condition is implied ('fold of control' mRNA expression) but the paper does not describe how the control dishes were prepared (e.g., transducer present but off).

The cells irradiated (HUVEC, cerebrovascular endothelial cells) are normal (non-diseased) cultures; 'alzheimers_disease' reflects the paper's stated therapeutic target application rather than a disease model of the cells themselves.

The manufacturer/model of the specific ultrasound probes used for the cell irradiation experiments (0.5/1.0/1.875 MHz) is not stated; only the probe used for the separate human intracranial sound-field design (Honda Electronics) is named.
Cultured vascular endothelial cells do not correspond to any anatomical brain/nerve target in the controlled vocabulary.

provenance.notes: This paper also measured ultrasound transmittance through 20 ex vivo human temporal bones (frequency 0.5 and 1.0 MHz) to characterize skull attenuation; this is a physical/acoustic characterization without a biological readout and was not recorded as a separate exposure.
